Write a small VERA module with jumpSearch, interpolationSearch, binarySearchIterative, binarySearchRecursive and isSortedArray. Search results are indices, or -1/null where specified; isSortedArray reports strict increasing order.

Required declarations and helper interfaces:
function jumpSearch(array: number[], target: number): number
function interpolationSearch(array: number[], target: number): number
function binarySearchIterative(array: number[], target: number): number | null
function binarySearchRecursiveRange(array: number[], target: number, start: number, end: number): number | null
function binarySearchRecursive(array: number[], target: number): number | null
